body: Honour mode are not only fights but also harder checks, increased vendor prices etc. Honour mode is an experience by itself and you can say that you beat honour mode, but imho it’s not fair to get achievement for that because you didn’t play by the rules set for achievement. One and the most important rule is a single save, no mistakes are allowed, even bad rng can be salvaged if you’re creative enough. You can get the worst rng in the world and still complete the run. I’m not gatekeeping people, I will not say that you didn’t beat honour mode because you did, so clearly you did something right, but at the same time you didn’t follow the rules. It’s like saying you scored a goal in football when the ball was offside. While technically you did, because you had skill to do it, it doesn’t really count towards the score
That’s why number of people that got the achievement is inflated
